summary: Russia launched a massive missile and drone attack involving 74 missiles and 284 UAVs, targeting various regions including Western Ukraine. The strikes caused significant civilian casualties and destruction, notably in the Luhansk, Kharkiv, and Dnipropetrovsk regions. Additionally, a Russian X-101 cruise missile reportedly fell in Poland near Tarnawa-Kolonia.
key_points: Russia launched a massive strike using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs across Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/83042).
A ballistic missile strike in Radudne, Dnipropetrovsk region, killed 6 people, including 3 children (Source: @UkraineNow/83013).
In Lviv, an attack caused approximately 34 casualties and damaged over 20 houses, a school, and two kindergartens (Source: @UkraineNow/83038).
A Russian X-101 cruise missile fell in the Lublin Voivodeship of Poland, creating a crater near Tarnawa-Kolonia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32039).
One person died in Pavlohrad following a strike on residential apartments (Source: @UkraineNow/83027).
The EU allocated €3.47 billion to Ukraine for purchasing drones, missiles, and fighter jets (Source: @UkraineNow/83030).
Russia targeted port infrastructure in the Odesa region, including a fuel pumping station in Novyi Bilyi (Source: @tass_agency/387916).
The Ukrainian Foreign Minister stated a Russian X-101 missile fell in Poland (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32039).

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive coordinated strike involving 74 missiles and 284 UAVs, causing significant civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. The attack targeted multiple regions, including Western Ukraine, with high impact in the Dnipropetrovsk and Lviv regions. A Russian X-101 cruise missile also landed in Poland, causing a crater near Tarnawa-Kolonia.

points: In the Dnipropetrovsk region, a ballistic missile hit a house in Radudne, killing 6 people, including 3 children, and injuring 8 others (Source: @UkraineNow/83013).
In Lviv, an attack damaged over 20 residential buildings, a school, and two kindergartens, resulting in approximately 34 casualties (Source: @UkraineNow/83038).
In Kyiv, one person died and three were injured following strikes that caused fires in the Obolon and Sviatoshyn districts (Source: @UkraineNow/83026).
In the Poltava region, one person died following a strike on warehouse premises (Source: @UkraineNow/83013).
In the Zhytomyr region, strikes in the Korosten district caused significant damage to over 300 houses across 4 villages (Source: @eRadarrua/103289).
In the Volyn region, a military commissar was involved in an incident where a driver rammed cars while attempting to avoid drafting (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32049).
Russian forces launched a massive attack using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs against Ukrainian territory (Source: @UkraineNow/83042).
Russian forces continue to strike ports and maritime vessels to target Ukrainian interests (Source: @tass_agency/387916).
Russian authorities are considering requiring foreign online platforms to register users via phone numbers and share data with security services (Source: @UkraineNow/83036).
Russian security services identified AI-generated fraudulent websites used to steal personal data of relatives of deceased military personnel (Source: @tass_agency/387955).
UAV activity was reported in the Kharkiv region towards Staryi Merchyk (Source: @eRadarrua/103277).

UAV activity was reported in the Chernihiv region towards Novhorod-Siverskyi (Source: @kpszsu/70795).
Russian UAV groups from the Black Sea were reported heading towards Odesa, Zatoka, and Tatarbuny (Source: @kpszsu/70804).
A Russian strike hit a fuel pumping station and fuel distribution node in Novyi Bilyi, Odesa region (Source: @tass_agency/387916).
UAV groups were reported heading towards Chornomorsk and Ovidiopol in the Odesa region (Source: @kpszsu/70791).
Russian UAV activity was reported over the Black Sea towards Crimea (Source: @eRadarrua/103295).

sections.threat_assessment: The scale of the Russian missile and drone strike, involving hundreds of units, indicates a high-intensity effort to overwhelm air defenses and target civilian infrastructure. The reported impact in Poland highlights the risk of collateral damage to NATO territory. The targeting of fuel infrastructure and ports suggests a strategic focus on disrupting logistics and energy supplies.
sections.regional_response: Poland has stated its air defenses are prepared to intercept missiles that approach its territory. The European Union is providing significant financial support, including a €3.47 billion tranche for advanced weaponry like drones and fighter jets. Bulgaria has taken control of Lukoil companies to protect national security interests.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of X-101 cruise missiles and ballistic weapons indicates a multi-layered strike profile. The targeting of residential areas in Lviv and Dnipropetrovsk suggests continued pressure on civilian populations. The reported fuel shortages in Moldova due to strikes on Russian refineries highlight the broader regional economic implications of the conflict.
